metaTitle: About Us & The Story Behind ETM
metaDescription: The story behind ETM - inspired by a childhood in Ethiopia rooted in faith, nature and simple daily living, and shaped by more than fifteen years in wellness.
heroText: A place to slow down, breathe deeply, and reconnect with your body.
storyBody:
ETM (Ethiopian Traditional Method) was inspired by a childhood rooted in faith, nature, and simple daily living.

Growing up in Ethiopia, wellbeing was woven into everyday life. Time outdoors, natural foods, movement, prayer, community, and regular fasting were part of a lifestyle that nurtured both body and mind. These simple rhythms became the foundation of a lifelong passion for holistic wellbeing.

After more than fifteen years of working in wellness and caring for people from many different backgrounds, I saw how modern life often leaves us disconnected from our bodies. Constant stress, busy schedules, poor sleep, and physical tension have become common experiences.

This inspired me to create ETM — a gentle approach that brings together timeless wisdom with modern understanding of the body. It encourages us to slow down, listen to our bodies, and build simple daily habits that support long-term wellbeing.
storyPull: ETM is not about quick fixes or perfection. It is about returning to the simple rhythms that help us care for ourselves — one careful step at a time.
storyImageQuote: Faith, nature, and simple daily living
whatBody:
ETM (Ethiopian Traditional Method) is a holistic approach that supports the body's natural ability to restore balance.

Each treatment combines therapeutic touch with gentle movement, breathwork, relaxation, and practical lifestyle guidance. Together, these elements help release tension, calm the nervous system, improve body awareness, and encourage overall wellbeing.
whatPull: Every session is personalised because every person is unique.

elements.label: One
elements.title: Therapeutic Touch
elements.text: Hands-on work grounded in years of practice. Unhurried, attentive, and always at a depth you are comfortable with.

elements.label: Two
elements.title: Breath
elements.text: Simple guided breathing to calm the nervous system, ease tension, and bring you back into the present moment.

elements.label: Three
elements.title: Movement
elements.text: Gentle, accessible movement to release stiffness, support mobility, and help you feel at home in your body again.

elements.label: Four
elements.title: Rest
elements.text: Real rest, treated as a practice rather than an afterthought. Learning how to let the body settle and restore.

elements.label: Five
elements.title: Healthy Daily Habits
elements.text: Small, sustainable rhythms around food, sleep, and routine that carry the work forward between sessions.

elements.label: Together
elements.title: Faith & Nature
elements.text: The foundation beneath it all. ETM was shaped by faith, by the natural world, and by paying close attention to what the body already knows.

expBody:
Every session begins by understanding you — your lifestyle, your goals, and how your body feels today.

Your treatment is then carefully tailored to your individual needs using ETM principles. Throughout your session, you will be encouraged to slow down, breathe naturally, and allow your body to relax.

The experience does not end when you leave. You will receive simple, practical guidance to help you continue caring for your wellbeing in everyday life.

steps.title: Understanding You
steps.text: We begin with a conversation. Your lifestyle, what brings you here, what you would like to feel differently, and how your body feels on the day.

steps.title: Tailored Treatment
steps.text: Your treatment is built from that conversation using ETM principles — therapeutic touch, breath, movement, and relaxation, weighted to what you need.

steps.title: Slowing Down
steps.text: Throughout, you are encouraged to slow down and breathe naturally. Nothing is rushed, and you set the depth and the pace at every stage.

steps.title: Beyond the Session
steps.text: You leave with simple, practical guidance — small habits and practices you can genuinely fit into everyday life.

practicalItems: Arrive a few minutes early so your session can begin unhurried
Wear comfortable clothing you can move in
Avoid a heavy meal in the two hours before your treatment
Come hydrated, and drink water afterwards
Let us know about any injuries, medication, or if you are pregnant
Keep the rest of your day gentle where you can
practicalImageQuote: Slow down. Breathe naturally. Let the body relax.
